name: Icehead
description: Iceheads were a species of sentient humanoids with lean, black bodies that held spiked, rectangular heads that resembled blocks of ice. Their large mouths brimmed with jagged teeth, and their three-fingered hands sported sharp claws. While they could walk like other humanoid species, members of the species could travel faster by flipping onto their heads and sliding on icy surfaces.

data.name: Icehead
data.distinctions: Can move on snow at full speed, can skate about on their heads
